name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 43 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 43 hours starting 2025-06-30, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
